evidence:
Scope: all 164 criterion descriptions were read (152 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual, 2 gates). Source review only; no configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index.json scope says full configured grading is absent), so run_verdict is NOT EXERCISED. sha256 of the files read: functional/judge.toml c01ac8be...6ef0, polish/judge.toml ab26c8f8...ae02, visual/judge.toml 947c4b12...ed75, gates/constraints/judge.toml 10b732f9...9e0c, gates/render/judge.toml 4f4ac012...d949, workbook 6d44970b...fd7f. I did not recompute the aggregate input_sha256.

What is sound (the large majority): bundled flows state one conjunctive bar and are not defects under the skill's known false positive and the workbook internal annotation (e.g. hro_relocation_approval functional/judge.toml:470, hro_competing :632, hro_desk_figures :1307). 'Owns X, not Y' sentences delimit scope rather than waive enumerated legs. Conditional clauses resolve to one bar per condition and match public optionality: the P5a 'absent claims are conforming' clause (e.g. :101, :146), hro_draft_eligibility :650 (instruction.md:17 makes imported history optional), hro_change_over_budget :920 (refusal at prepare or commit, one outcome). Fallback witnesses keep the same outcome on a different record and say what is still required (hro_cancel :578 'historical-grant protection still needs a completed revision witness'; hro_referral_immutable :542 'need all three operation kinds'). 'NOT EXERCISED' wording in binary rows (hro_keep_rescission_date :1388, hro_change_retry_restart :1127) is reconciled to a single score by functional/prompt.md:15 ('return0 with reason "NOT EXERCISED ..."'). Visual likert anchors are monotone and single-target.

Instance 1 (defect) - hro_revision_role_recruiter, functional/judge.toml:254: "Reuse prior observations; a minimal base change suffices, and formula correctness has separate credit. Include a Recruiter revision into BandIII on an ample budget without a new approval or tier check." One sentence says a minimal base change is sufficient for credit; the next adds a mandatory leg that a minimal change cannot satisfy. The sibling reviser rows (:272, :281, :290, :299) carry the same 'minimal base change suffices' sentence with no extra leg, which makes the sufficiency reading the natural one. The Band III leg is publicly backed (hireops_rules.md:241 'does not require another approval or a new tier check'), so the leg is legitimate; the wording leaves two targets. Weight 0.06889564 of 74.0 functional, so score impact is small.

Instance 2 (defect) - hro_pol_focus, polish/judge.toml:41: "Read document.activeElement after three outcomes ... If no commit refusal can be obtained, decide on the two save outcomes." The full-credit bar is three focus outcomes, or two when the third cannot be produced. The same suite's hro_pol_change_recovery (:50) treats the identical situation the opposite way ('If no genuine refusal can be observed, give no unobserved recovery credit'). Weight 1.5 of 12 polish.

Minor wording (not counted as defects): the four allowed tier/band rows (hro_tier_1_band_1 :371, hro_tier_2_band_2 :389, hro_tier_3_band_1 :407, hro_tier_3_band_3 :416) carry the inapplicable boilerplate 'For a refusal, this same actor must first successfully approve an in-range control'; it adds no second bar. hro_change_history :1109 grades 'each artifact that exists' and does not say what to score when none of the three artifacts exists.
counterexample: Instance 1: an app lets the Recruiter revise a committed offer for a small base change but returns 403 (re-applies a tier check) when the revision moves the basis into Band III. A judge reading 'a minimal base change suffices' awards hro_revision_role_recruiter; a judge reading 'Include a Recruiter revision into BandIII' gives 0. Same app, two verdicts, both defensible from the text. Conversely a judge short on budget may skip the Band III leg for a conforming app and still pass it, so the leg is not reliably measured. Instance 2: app A never refuses a commit (its freshness check is dead) and moves focus correctly after the two save outcomes: hro_pol_focus passes on the two-outcome bar. App B refuses the stale commit correctly but leaves focus on the pressed button: fails on the three-outcome bar. The weaker app is held to the lower bar.
suggested_fix: hro_revision_role_recruiter: delete 'a minimal base change suffices' for this row and state the single bar, e.g. 'Rafael Costa, Recruiter successfully revises a separate current committed offer into Band III on an ample budget through the UI with no new approval or tier check' (or move the Band III leg to its own criterion and keep the minimal-change bar here). hro_pol_focus: state one bar - either require all three outcomes and give 0 with a NOT EXERCISED reason when the commit refusal cannot be obtained (matching hro_pol_change_recovery), or define the row on the two save outcomes only and move commit-refusal focus elsewhere. Optionally drop the 'For a refusal ...' sentence from the four allowed tier/band rows.
